The '''Ertraxi''' were a peaceful [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with multiple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ertrax]]. At some point, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crash-landed on the planet, and the Ertraxi eventually repaired the vessel and flew it offworld in order to contact other species. They subsequently made first contact with a group of [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], who informed the wider [[galactic community]] of the discovery of the species and their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], prompting [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], and would-be conquerors to attempt to exploit Ertrax.

==Biology and appearance==
The Ertraxi were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] who had multiple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

==Society and culture==
The Ertraxi had an essentially peaceful culture.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

{{RPGseed}}
When the species was discovered by off-worlders, the former displayed a trusting nature and did not suspect they could be facing exploitation.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
{{Endgame}}

==History==
The Ertraxi [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ertrax system/Legends|Ertrax system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ertrax]]. At some point, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crash-landed on Ertrax, leaving no survivors. The Ertraxi repaired the wrecked ship over the span of several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and then flew it offworld in order to make contact with other species and cultures.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

{{RPGseed}}
Shortly after, a group of [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] charting the far reaches of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] found a trail of [[Cronau radiation/Legends|Cronau radiation]] left behind by the starship and followed it, leading them to discover Ertrax and make first contact with the natives. After the explorers brought news of their discovery back to the wider [[galactic community]], however, they learned the information had motivated many opportunistic [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]], and would-be conquerors to travel to Ertrax in order to exploit the newly found world.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ScumAndVillainy-WotC.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Ertraxi were introduced in the sourcebook ''Scum and Villainy''.]]
The Ertraxi were first mentioned in [[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']], a [[2008]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The species was introduced as part of a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure seed that suggests two possible courses of action for the player characters regarding their discovery of Ertrax: The characters can either keep the reward offered for the information on the newfound planet, or they can forfeit the fee by returning to Ertrax and helping the Ertraxi protect themselves against the threat of exploitation, either by warning and arming the natives or by assisting them with gaining a Republic membership.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
